jp: \t\t縁起物とされる赤い色の玩具。異国では眼が書かれていない物が主流で、願いがかなう度にそこに黒い染料で目を書き入れるのだという。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t縁起物とされる赤い色の玩具。異国では眼が書かれていない物が主流で、願いがかなう度にそこに黒い染料で目を書き入れるのだという。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n"
en: A red-colored toy considered a good-luck charm. In foreign countries, the most common toy has no eyes written on it, and every time a wish is granted, an eye is drawn on it with black dye. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~
en_grezzo: "A red-colored toy considered a good-luck charm. In foreign countries, the most common toy has no eyes written on it, and every time a wish is granted, an eye is drawn on it with black dye. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~"
it: Un balocco rosso che si tiene per portafortuna. In terra straniera vanno per lo più quelli senza occhi dipinti: ogni volta che un desiderio si avvera, gliene si disegna uno con l'inchiostro nero. \n# ~Regali che Fa Piacere Ricevere~

jp: \t\t寒い季節に使用される暖房家具。潜り込むと気分は洞窟探検者、そんなことを言いながらそのまま中で眠りこける子供が後を絶たないという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t寒い季節に使用される暖房家具。潜り込むと気分は洞窟探検者、そんなことを言いながらそのまま中で眠りこける子供が後を絶たないという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Heating furniture used in the cold season. It is said that there is no end to the number of children who fall asleep in them, saying that they feel like cave explorers when they crawl into them. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Heating furniture used in the cold season. It is said that there is no end to the number of children who fall asleep in them, saying that they feel like cave explorers when they crawl into them. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un mobile che scalda, per la stagione fredda. A infilarcisi sotto ci si sente esploratori di caverne, e pare che i bambini che lo dicono e poi si addormentano lì dentro non finiscano mai. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t地下へようこそ！この優れた道具は、一瞬にして地下空間に繋がる道を作ってしまうのだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t地下へようこそ！この優れた道具は、一瞬にして地下空間に繋がる道を作ってしまうのだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Welcome to the underground! This excellent tool instantly creates a path that leads to underground space. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Welcome to the underground! This excellent tool instantly creates a path that leads to underground space. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Benvenuti nel sottosuolo! Questo attrezzo eccellente apre in un attimo una via che porta agli spazi sotterranei. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t地上へおかえり！この優れた道具は、一瞬にして外界へと繋がる道を作ってしまうのだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t地上へおかえり！この優れた道具は、一瞬にして外界へと繋がる道を作ってしまうのだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Welcome to the overworld! This excellent tool instantly creates a path that leads to the outside world. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Welcome to the overworld! This excellent tool instantly creates a path that leads to the outside world. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Bentornati in superficie! Questo attrezzo eccellente apre in un attimo una via che porta al mondo di fuori. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t自らの気持ちを代わりに伝える時に用いる贈答品。無論、使用することはできない。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t自らの気持ちを代わりに伝える時に用いる贈答品。無論、使用することはできない。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n"
en: A gift used to convey one's feelings on one's own behalf. Of course, it cannot be used. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~
en_grezzo: "A gift used to convey one's feelings on one's own behalf. Of course, it cannot be used. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~"
it: Un dono che si usa per dire, al posto proprio, quel che si sente. Naturalmente non si può usare. \n# ~Regali che Fa Piacere Ricevere~

jp: \t\t神の落とし物とも言われる、非常に上質なベッド。その優しい肌触りは寝る者の心を豊かにするという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t神の落とし物とも言われる、非常に上質なベッド。その優しい肌触りは寝る者の心を豊かにするという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A very high quality bed, said to be God's gift to the world. Its gentle touch is said to enrich the hearts of those who sleep on it. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A very high quality bed, said to be God's gift to the world. Its gentle touch is said to enrich the hearts of those who sleep on it. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un letto di qualità altissima, che qualcuno dice perduto da un dio. Quel tocco gentile, dicono, fa ricco il cuore di chi ci dorme.\n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t演奏の名手の元に訪れるという伝説のヴァイオリン。その音色は聴衆の心に大きく響き、奏者へ感謝の贈り物をする者が後を絶たないという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t演奏の名手の元に訪れるという伝説のヴァイオリン。その音色は聴衆の心に大きく響き、奏者へ感謝の贈り物をする者が後を絶たないという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: The legendary violin is said to be a favorite of virtuoso performers. Its sound resonates so loudly in the hearts of its listeners that there is no end to the number of people who give the violinist a gift of appreciation. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "The legendary violin is said to be a favorite of virtuoso performers. Its sound resonates so loudly in the hearts of its listeners that there is no end to the number of people who give the violinist a gift of appreciation. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Il violino leggendario che, si dice, va a cercarsi i maestri dell'esecuzione. Il suo timbro risuona forte nel cuore di chi ascolta, e non finiscono mai quelli che fanno un dono di riconoscenza a chi suona. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t部屋の仕切りとして用いられる家具。お洒落な雰囲気を家に醸し出すことができる。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t部屋の仕切りとして用いられる家具。お洒落な雰囲気を家に醸し出すことができる。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Furniture used as room dividers. It can create a stylish atmosphere in a house. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Furniture used as room dividers. It can create a stylish atmosphere in a house. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un mobile che si usa per dividere le stanze. Dà alla casa un'aria di eleganza. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t両手で持ち弦を弾いて音を出す弦楽器。持ち運びには適さないが、そのゆったりとした音は聴衆を優雅な気分にさせることだろう。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t両手で持ち弦を弾いて音を出す弦楽器。持ち運びには適さないが、そのゆったりとした音は聴衆を優雅な気分にさせることだろう。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A stringed instrument that is held with both hands and the strings are plucked to produce sound. It is not suitable for carrying around, but its relaxing sound will make the audience feel elegant. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A stringed instrument that is held with both hands and the strings are plucked to produce sound. It is not suitable for carrying around, but its relaxing sound will make the audience feel elegant. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Uno strumento a corde che si tiene con tutte e due le mani e suona a pizzico. Portarselo dietro non è comodo, ma il suo suono disteso metterà chi ascolta in uno stato d'animo elegante. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t軽い音で旋律を奏でる特殊な楽器。小さな体から発せられる楽しげな音は、聞いている方まで楽しくさせるという。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t軽い音で旋律を奏でる特殊な楽器。小さな体から発せられる楽しげな音は、聞いている方まで楽しくさせるという。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A special instrument that plays a melody with a light sound. The joyful sound emitted from its small body is said to make even the listener happy. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A special instrument that plays a melody with a light sound. The joyful sound emitted from its small body is said to make even the listener happy. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Uno strumento particolare, che porta la melodia con un suono leggero. Il suono allegro che esce da quel corpo piccolo, dicono, mette allegria anche a chi ascolta. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t掻き鳴らすことで音を発す弦楽器。卵を縦半分に切ったような特異な形状は、内部に音を反響させ、音色に深みを与えることに一役買っている。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t掻き鳴らすことで音を発す弦楽器。卵を縦半分に切ったような特異な形状は、内部に音を反響させ、音色に深みを与えることに一役買っている。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A stringed instrument that produces sound by scratching. Its peculiar shape, which resembles an egg cut in half lengthwise, helps to reverberate the sound inside and give depth to the tone. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A stringed instrument that produces sound by scratching. Its peculiar shape, which resembles an egg cut in half lengthwise, helps to reverberate the sound inside and give depth to the tone. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Uno strumento a corde che dà suono se lo si gratta. La forma singolare, come un uovo tagliato per il lungo, serve a far risuonare il suono all'interno e a dare profondità al timbro. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t幾つかの管を重ねた管楽器。音程が安定しにくく、これを扱う演奏家は絶えず調律する必要があるという。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t幾つかの管を重ねた管楽器。音程が安定しにくく、これを扱う演奏家は絶えず調律する必要があるという。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A wind instrument consisting of several layered tubes. It is said to be difficult to keep the pitch stable, so players who handle it need to tune it constantly. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A wind instrument consisting of several layered tubes. It is said to be difficult to keep the pitch stable, so players who handle it need to tune it constantly. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Uno strumento a fiato fatto di più canne accostate. L'intonazione fa fatica a restare ferma, e chi lo suona deve accordarlo di continuo. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t折りたたむことができる、雰囲気ある間仕切り。かつて異国の若い僧侶がこれの一つに封じ込まれた虎を倒そうとしたことがあるとか。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t折りたたむことができる、雰囲気ある間仕切り。かつて異国の若い僧侶がこれの一つに封じ込まれた虎を倒そうとしたことがあるとか。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: An atmospheric partition that can be folded. A young monk from another country once tried to defeat a tiger enclosed in one of these. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "An atmospheric partition that can be folded. A young monk from another country once tried to defeat a tiger enclosed in one of these. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un paravento pieghevole, di quelli che fanno atmosfera. Pare che in terra straniera un giovane monaco abbia provato una volta ad abbattere la tigre chiusa dentro uno di questi. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t持ち運びやすいように作られた照明器具。装飾品としても扱われる他、異国では、ガードが夜警の為に持ち歩いているという話だ。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t持ち運びやすいように作られた照明器具。装飾品としても扱われる他、異国では、ガードが夜警の為に持ち歩いているという話だ。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: Lighting devices made to be easily carried around. Besides being treated as ornaments, it is said that in foreign countries, guards carry them with them for night watch. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "Lighting devices made to be easily carried around. Besides being treated as ornaments, it is said that in foreign countries, guards carry them with them for night watch. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Un lume fatto per portarlo in giro comodamente. Oltre a servire da ornamento, in terra straniera pare che le guardie se lo portino appresso per la ronda di notte. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\t異国情緒あふれる丸型の窓。取り付ければ何となく外国を訪れている気分にさせるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t異国情緒あふれる丸型の窓。取り付ければ何となく外国を訪れている気分にさせるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Exotic round windows. When installed, they are said to make people feel as if they are visiting a foreign country. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Exotic round windows. When installed, they are said to make people feel as if they are visiting a foreign country. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una finestra tonda, tutta profumo di terre lontane. Montata in casa, dicono, mette addosso la sensazione di essere in viaggio all'estero. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t照明を安置する為の石造りの構造物。これが一台あるだけで周囲が厳かな雰囲気に包まれるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t照明を安置する為の石造りの構造物。これが一台あるだけで周囲が厳かな雰囲気に包まれるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A stone structure used to enshrine lighting. It is said that the mere presence of one of these lamps creates a solemn atmosphere in the surrounding area. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A stone structure used to enshrine lighting. It is said that the mere presence of one of these lamps creates a solemn atmosphere in the surrounding area. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una costruzione di pietra fatta per posarci dentro un lume. Basta che ce ne sia una perché tutto intorno si riempia di un'aria solenne. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t２人用のやや幅広な寝具。想定人数は２人だが詰めれば４人までいけるので、困窮にあえぐ冒険者の一団が金額を折半して皆でこのベッドに寝ることもあるようだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t２人用のやや幅広な寝具。想定人数は２人だが詰めれば４人までいけるので、困窮にあえぐ冒険者の一団が金額を折半して皆でこのベッドに寝ることもあるようだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A rather wide bedding for two. The beds are designed for two people, but can accommodate up to four if they are packed together, so a group of adventurers in dire straits may split the cost and sleep together on these beds. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A rather wide bedding for two. The beds are designed for two people, but can accommodate up to four if they are packed together, so a group of adventurers in dire straits may split the cost and sleep together on these beds. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un letto un po' largo, per due. Il conto è di due persone, ma stringendosi ci si sta anche in quattro, e capita che una brigata di avventurieri al verde divida la spesa e ci dorma tutta insieme.\n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t不用品をかき集め、うず高く積んだとても重い物体。本来持ち運ぶようなものではないが、どうしても持ち運ばなければならない事情がある時は、廃品の一部にならないように細心の注意を払おう。\n#～私の愛する幾千ものガラクタ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t不用品をかき集め、うず高く積んだとても重い物体。本来持ち運ぶようなものではないが、どうしても持ち運ばなければならない事情がある時は、廃品の一部にならないように細心の注意を払おう。\n#～私の愛する幾千ものガラクタ～\n"
en: Unused items are gathered up and piled up high in a very heavy pile. It is not something you would normally carry, but if you have to carry it under certain circumstances, be very careful not to become part of the waste. \n#~Thousands of pieces of Junk I love~
en_grezzo: "Unused items are gathered up and piled up high in a very heavy pile. It is not something you would normally carry, but if you have to carry it under certain circumstances, be very careful not to become part of the waste. \n#~Thousands of pieces of Junk I love~"
it: Roba inutile raccattata e ammucchiata fin su, pesantissima. Non è cosa che di solito si porti in giro; ma se proprio tocca farlo, conviene stare attentissimi a non finire parte del mucchio.\n#~Le Mille Cianfrusaglie che Amo~

jp: \t\t水周りの仕事を一手に引き受ける流し台。非常に巨大で重量もある為持ち運びには注意が必要だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t水周りの仕事を一手に引き受ける流し台。非常に巨大で重量もある為持ち運びには注意が必要だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A sink that takes care of all water-related work. It is very huge and heavy, so care must be taken when carrying it. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A sink that takes care of all water-related work. It is very huge and heavy, so care must be taken when carrying it. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un lavello che si prende in carico tutto il lavoro dell'acqua. È enorme e pesa molto, quindi a portarlo in giro ci vuole attenzione. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\tその道のプロが精魂込めて作り上げた食器棚。一見シンプルに見えるが、普段見えない部分に匠の遊び心が隠れている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tその道のプロが精魂込めて作り上げた食器棚。一見シンプルに見えるが、普段見えない部分に匠の遊び心が隠れている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A cupboard created by professionals who put their hearts and souls into their work. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A cupboard created by professionals who put their hearts and souls into their work. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una credenza costruita con tutta l'anima da chi è maestro del mestiere. A prima vista sembra semplice, ma nelle parti che di solito non si vedono si nasconde l'estro dell'artigiano. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t小さな花達を守る為、簡易な塀が取り付けられている花壇だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t小さな花達を守る為、簡易な塀が取り付けられている花壇だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A flower bed with a simple fence attached to protect the small flowers. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A flower bed with a simple fence attached to protect the small flowers. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un'aiuola a cui hanno montato una recinzione semplice, per proteggere i fiori piccoli. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\tゆったりとした安定感抜群の長椅子。我が家でくつろぐには最適な家具だろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tゆったりとした安定感抜群の長椅子。我が家でくつろぐには最適な家具だろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A spacious and stable chaise longue. It would be the perfect furniture for relaxing in one's own home. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A spacious and stable chaise longue. It would be the perfect furniture for relaxing in one's own home. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un divano ampio, di una stabilità eccellente. È il mobile giusto per starsene in pace a casa propria. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t白墨で書かれた文字を書き消しできる巨大な板。大抵の学び舎にはこの板が備え付けられているという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t白墨で書かれた文字を書き消しできる巨大な板。大抵の学び舎にはこの板が備え付けられているという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A huge board on which letters written in white ink can be written and erased. Most schools are equipped with this board. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A huge board on which letters written in white ink can be written and erased. Most schools are equipped with this board. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una tavola enorme su cui si scrive col gesso bianco e si cancella. Quasi tutte le scuole ne hanno una. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t品書が書かれた板。お店のオススメなる料理が書かれているが、それがどこの町のものかは定かではない。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t品書が書かれた板。お店のオススメなる料理が書かれているが、それがどこの町のものかは定かではない。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: A board with a list of items. It contains the restaurant's recommended dishes, but it is not certain which town they are from. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "A board with a list of items. It contains the restaurant's recommended dishes, but it is not certain which town they are from. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Una tavola con scritta la lista dei piatti. Ci sono le specialità del locale, ma di che città siano non è chiaro. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\t国王御用達の誉れ高い箪笥。機能性を損なう程に鮮やかな装飾がなされている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t国王御用達の誉れ高い箪笥。機能性を損なう程に鮮やかな装飾がなされている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A cabinet of drawers honored by the King's warrant. It is so brilliantly decorated that its functionality is compromised. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A cabinet of drawers honored by the King's warrant. It is so brilliantly decorated that its functionality is compromised. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una cassettiera di gran fama, fornitrice del re. È decorata così vivacemente da rimetterci in funzionalità. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t間仕切りが付けられた室内用窓。覗きを嫌うレイディー達がこぞって買っていくという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t間仕切りが付けられた室内用窓。覗きを嫌うレイディー達がこぞって買っていくという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: An interior window with a partition attached. It is said that ladies who don't like peeping are buying them all the time. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "An interior window with a partition attached. It is said that ladies who don't like peeping are buying them all the time. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una finestra da interni con un divisorio montato sopra. Dicono che le dame a cui dà noia essere spiate la comprino a gara. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t穀物が詰まった藁製の袋。風通しが良く穀物が傷みにくい為、広く使われている。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t穀物が詰まった藁製の袋。風通しが良く穀物が傷みにくい為、広く使われている。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: Straw bags filled with grain. Widely used because of its good ventilation and resistance to damage of grains. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "Straw bags filled with grain. Widely used because of its good ventilation and resistance to damage of grains. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Un sacco di paglia pieno di granaglie. Si usa molto perché lascia passare l'aria e il grano si guasta poco. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\t何やら危険な感じのする門。怪しく揺らめく光の中から、時折異形の姿や悲鳴が聞こえることがあるという。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t何やら危険な感じのする門。怪しく揺らめく光の中から、時折異形の姿や悲鳴が聞こえることがあるという。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: Gate that looks suspiciously dangerous. From the mysterious flickering light, it is said that sometimes an unusual figure or a scream can be heard. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "Gate that looks suspiciously dangerous. From the mysterious flickering light, it is said that sometimes an unusual figure or a scream can be heard. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Un portale che dà una sensazione di pericolo. Dicono che dentro quella luce che ondeggia inquieta si vedano a tratti figure deformi, o si sentano delle grida.\n#~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~

jp: \t\t異国の神の領域を主張するという木製の門。赤色に染められたそれは、何処となく生命の躍動を感じさせる。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t異国の神の領域を主張するという木製の門。赤色に染められたそれは、何処となく生命の躍動を感じさせる。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: Wooden gate that claims the domain of Gods of the foreign lands. Tinted red, it somehow evokes the vibrancy of life. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "Wooden gate that claims the domain of Gods of the foreign lands. Tinted red, it somehow evokes the vibrancy of life. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Un portale di legno che, si dice, segna il dominio di un dio straniero. Tinto di rosso, ha in sé qualcosa che fa pensare allo slancio della vita.\n#~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~

jp: \t\t花で飾られた弓形の建造物。潜り抜ける際に若干の気恥ずかしさを感じるのは一体何故だろうか。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t花で飾られた弓形の建造物。潜り抜ける際に若干の気恥ずかしさを感じるのは一体何故だろうか。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: An arched structure decorated with flowers. Why on earth do I feel a little embarrassed when I go through it? \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "An arched structure decorated with flowers. Why on earth do I feel a little embarrassed when I go through it? \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Una costruzione ad arco ornata di fiori. Come mai, a passarci sotto, si prova un po' di imbarazzo? \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\t国王御用達の誉れ高い寝具。柔らかな眠り心地はいうまでも無く、様々な贅を凝らして作られたこのベッドは、家具を愛する者にとって最大の憧れである。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t国王御用達の誉れ高い寝具。柔らかな眠り心地はいうまでも無く、様々な贅を凝らして作られたこのベッドは、家具を愛する者にとって最大の憧れである。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Bedding acclaimed by the King's warrant. This bed, which is made with various luxuries, not to mention its soft and comfortable sleep, is the greatest dream for those who love furniture. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Bedding acclaimed by the King's warrant. This bed, which is made with various luxuries, not to mention its soft and comfortable sleep, is the greatest dream for those who love furniture. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un letto di gran fama, fornitore del re. Del sonno morbido non c'è nemmeno da dire: fatto com'è con ogni sorta di lusso, è il sogno più grande di chi ama i mobili.\n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\tくつろげる空間を演出する窓。窓枠から差し込む暖かな光は、一時の安らぎをあなたに提供するだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tくつろげる空間を演出する窓。窓枠から差し込む暖かな光は、一時の安らぎをあなたに提供するだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Windows that create a relaxing space. The warm light shining through the window frame will provide you with temporary peace of mind. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Windows that create a relaxing space. The warm light shining through the window frame will provide you with temporary peace of mind. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una finestra che mette in scena uno spazio in cui riposare. La luce tiepida che entra dal telaio saprà dare un momento di quiete. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t程良く人の手が入った植物。どれだけ時間がたってもその形状が崩れないのは、恐らく人知れず綺麗に刈り取っていく辻庭師がいるからなのだろう。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t程良く人の手が入った植物。どれだけ時間がたってもその形状が崩れないのは、恐らく人知れず綺麗に刈り取っていく辻庭師がいるからなのだろう。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: A plant that has been well taken care of by people. The reason why it does not lose its shape no matter how much time passes is probably due to the presence of a street gardener who neatly trims it away without people knowing about it. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "A plant that has been well taken care of by people. The reason why it does not lose its shape no matter how much time passes is probably due to the presence of a street gardener who neatly trims it away without people knowing about it. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta curata dall'uomo quanto basta. Se non perde mai la forma per quanto tempo passi, sarà perché c'è un giardiniere di strada che la pota per bene senza farsi vedere. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t広く見かける一般的な窓。これといって目立つ特徴はないが、比較的手に入りやすいので広く流通している。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t広く見かける一般的な窓。これといって目立つ特徴はないが、比較的手に入りやすいので広く流通している。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: These are common windows that are widely found. It has no outstanding features, but is widely distributed because it is relatively easy to obtain. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "These are common windows that are widely found. It has no outstanding features, but is widely distributed because it is relatively easy to obtain. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una finestra comune, di quelle che si vedono dappertutto. Non ha nessuna particolarità di rilievo, ma si trova facilmente e per questo circola molto. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t硬い金属の枠組みが特徴的の窓。その硬さはかつて何処かの収容所で採用されたほどだという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t硬い金属の枠組みが特徴的の窓。その硬さはかつて何処かの収容所で採用されたほどだという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The window is characterized by its hard metal frame. Its hardness is said to be so great that it was once used in a prison camp somewhere. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The window is characterized by its hard metal frame. Its hardness is said to be so great that it was once used in a prison camp somewhere. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una finestra che si riconosce dal telaio di metallo duro. Tanto duro, dicono, che una volta lo adottarono in un campo di prigionia. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t愛嬌のある形をした植物。夜、人々が寝静まった頃、この植物はそっと鉢から抜けだし街の外を自由に駆け回っている、という作り話が近年パルミアで人々の笑いを誘っている。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t愛嬌のある形をした植物。夜、人々が寝静まった頃、この植物はそっと鉢から抜けだし街の外を自由に駆け回っている、という作り話が近年パルミアで人々の笑いを誘っている。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Plant with a charming shape. In recent years, there is a Palmian urban legend, involving a plant that quietly slips out of its pot at night when people are asleep and runs freely outside the city, which has drawn laughter in Palmia. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Plant with a charming shape. In recent years, there is a Palmian urban legend, involving a plant that quietly slips out of its pot at night when people are asleep and runs freely outside the city, which has drawn laughter in Palmia. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta dalla forma simpatica. Di notte, quando tutti dormono, sguscerebbe piano dal vaso e correrebbe libera fuori città: è una frottola che in questi anni a Palmia fa ridere la gente. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t直火を用いる優れた調理器具。これで調理した際に広がる香ばしい匂いは、食べる者にとって最高の調味料となろう。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t直火を用いる優れた調理器具。これで調理した際に広がる香ばしい匂いは、食べる者にとって最高の調味料となろう。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n"
en: An excellent cooking utensil that uses an open flame. The savory smell that spreads when cooking with it will be the best seasoning for those who eat with it. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~
en_grezzo: "An excellent cooking utensil that uses an open flame. The savory smell that spreads when cooking with it will be the best seasoning for those who eat with it. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~"
it: Un ottimo arnese da cucina che lavora a fiamma viva. Il profumo tostato che si spande cucinandoci sarà il miglior condimento per chi mangia. \n# ~I Comprimari della Cucina~

jp: \t\t南国気分を味わえる鉢植え。お金が無い時はこの鉢植えを買って、是非とも南国へ行った気分に浸ろう。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t南国気分を味わえる鉢植え。お金が無い時はこの鉢植えを買って、是非とも南国へ行った気分に浸ろう。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Tropical potted plants. If you don't have the money, buy this potted plant and enjoy the tropical atmosphere by all means. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Tropical potted plants. If you don't have the money, buy this potted plant and enjoy the tropical atmosphere by all means. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso che dà un'aria da paese tropicale. Quando i soldi non ci sono, si compri questo vaso e ci si immagini di essere ai tropici. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t目の疲れを取ってくれるという鉢植え。それが対外的による物なのか体内摂取によるものなのかは、売っている人間にしか知る由はない。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t目の疲れを取ってくれるという鉢植え。それが対外的による物なのか体内摂取によるものなのかは、売っている人間にしか知る由はない。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Potted plant that is said to relieve eye fatigue. Whether this is used externally or taken internally, only the seller can know. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Potted plant that is said to relieve eye fatigue. Whether this is used externally or taken internally, only the seller can know. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso che, dicono, toglie la stanchezza dagli occhi. Se sia per via esterna o perché va ingerita, lo sa solo chi la vende. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\tゆったりとした座り心地を提供する威厳ある椅子。聞くところによると左手にシルバーキャット、右手にウィスキーを持つのがこの椅子の正式な座り方らしい。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tゆったりとした座り心地を提供する威厳ある椅子。聞くところによると左手にシルバーキャット、右手にウィスキーを持つのがこの椅子の正式な座り方らしい。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A dignified chair that offers a comfortable and relaxed atmosphere. From what I hear, the official way to sit in this chair is to hold a silver cat in your left hand and a whiskey in your right. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A dignified chair that offers a comfortable and relaxed atmosphere. From what I hear, the official way to sit in this chair is to hold a silver cat in your left hand and a whiskey in your right. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una poltrona autorevole, che offre una seduta distesa. A quel che si dice, il modo ufficiale di sedercisi è con un gatto d'argento nella mano sinistra e un whisky nella destra. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t芸術家の粋を集めた偉大な作品。それを通して差し込む光は、人々に感動と驚きを与える。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t芸術家の粋を集めた偉大な作品。それを通して差し込む光は、人々に感動と驚きを与える。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Great works of art created by the best of artists. The light that shines through it moves and amazes people. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Great works of art created by the best of artists. The light that shines through it moves and amazes people. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una grande opera che raccoglie il fior fiore dell'arte. La luce che entra passandoci attraverso commuove e stupisce. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t天井を支える目的に特化した柱。その独特な形状により通常の柱よりずっと重い重量を支えることができる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t天井を支える目的に特化した柱。その独特な形状により通常の柱よりずっと重い重量を支えることができる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Pillars specialized for the purpose of supporting ceilings. Its unique shape allows it to support much heavier weights than ordinary columns. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Pillars specialized for the purpose of supporting ceilings. Its unique shape allows it to support much heavier weights than ordinary columns. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una colonna fatta apposta per sostenere il soffitto. La forma singolare le permette di reggere un peso molto maggiore di una colonna normale. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t尊き存在の力と権力を体現した調度品。その大きさは見る者を圧倒させ、自ずとひざまずいてしまう程だという。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t尊き存在の力と権力を体現した調度品。その大きさは見る者を圧倒させ、自ずとひざまずいてしまう程だという。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: The furnishings are the embodiment of the power and authority of a divine being. Its size is said to overwhelm those who see it, so much so that they are forced to kneel down. \n# ~Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "The furnishings are the embodiment of the power and authority of a divine being. Its size is said to overwhelm those who see it, so much so that they are forced to kneel down. \n# ~Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Una suppellettile che incarna la forza e l'autorità di un essere sublime. È così grande, dicono, da schiacciare chi la guarda e fargli piegare le ginocchia da sé. \n# ~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~

jp: \t\t雪のお陰でお洒落に磨きがかかった街灯。雪降る夜、長身の紳士が優しく照らす光は、恋する二人に火を灯すという。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t雪のお陰でお洒落に磨きがかかった街灯。雪降る夜、長身の紳士が優しく照らす光は、恋する二人に火を灯すという。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: A street lamp, fashionably polished thanks to the snow. It is said that the light gently illuminated by a tall gentleman on a snowy night will light a fire between two people in love. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "A street lamp, fashionably polished thanks to the snow. It is said that the light gently illuminated by a tall gentleman on a snowy night will light a fire between two people in love. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Un lampione che la neve ha reso ancora più elegante. Nelle notti di neve la luce che questo signore allampanato getta con dolcezza, dicono, accende il fuoco fra due innamorati. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\t寒空に置かれ、白い化粧で身を飾ったタル。その姿はある種の芸術品と見紛う程だ。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t寒空に置かれ、白い化粧で身を飾ったタル。その姿はある種の芸術品と見紛う程だ。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: Placed in the cold air, and adorned with white makeup of snow, the figure of this barrel could be mistaken for some kind of work of art. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "Placed in the cold air, and adorned with white makeup of snow, the figure of this barrel could be mistaken for some kind of work of art. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Un barile posato sotto il cielo freddo, che si è truccato di bianco. A vederlo, lo si scambierebbe per un'opera d'arte. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\t身近に雪を感じたいという意見から生み出された小型の雪だるま。その愛らしい表情は小さくなっても変わることなく世界を見つめ続けている。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t身近に雪を感じたいという意見から生み出された小型の雪だるま。その愛らしい表情は小さくなっても変わることなく世界を見つめ続けている。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n"
en: This small-sized snowman was created from the opinion that people want to feel snow close at hand. The adorable expression on his face remains unchanged even in his smaller size as he continues to gaze out at the world. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~
en_grezzo: "This small-sized snowman was created from the opinion that people want to feel snow close at hand. The adorable expression on his face remains unchanged even in his smaller size as he continues to gaze out at the world. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~"
it: Un pupazzo di neve piccolo, nato dall'idea di avere la neve a portata di mano. Quel muso adorabile non cambia nemmeno rimpicciolito, e continua a guardare il mondo. \n# ~Viaggio in Tyris del Nord: Inverno~
